articles.title: Strikes and threats as Iran war approaches two-week mark
articles.summary: As the Middle East conflict enters its second week, leaders from Iran, Israel, and the United States have voiced defiance, vowing to fight on. The intensifying war has claimed thousands of lives and caused widespread disruption. This ongoing international crisis highlights the complex geopolitical landscape and the firm commitment of involved nations to their respective positions.

articles.title: ‘Seekers Of Infinite Love’ Review: Hannah Einbinder and Justin Theroux Star In Smart Cult Comedy That’s Worthy Of A Cult Of Its Own – SXSW
articles.summary: Victoria Strouse's new comedy, 'Seeker', focusing on dysfunctional siblings, premieres tonight at SXSW. Strouse, known for 'Finding Dory', brings this anticipated film to the renowned festival. This event highlights significant developments in the international film circuit, offering aspirants insights into global cultural trends and major cinematic releases.
